backendOnlyContracts.owner: th.co.scb.ace.demo.recovery.casewf.migration.RecoveryMigrationProperties (binding) and MigrationPropertiesConfig (registration, new, package-private, no condition)
backendOnlyContracts.constraint: @Validated on the record; @NotNull and @Pattern(regexp = "recovery", message = "rwb.schema must be recovery (D-RCV-28)") on schema
backendOnlyContracts.whenChecked: when Spring binds the record, on every start, whatever rwb.flyway.enabled is; not in a constructor or compact constructor, so code-built records are unaffected
backendOnlyContracts.failure: ConfigurationPropertiesBindException whose chain holds BindValidationException; the message names rwb.schema, the value found and D-RCV-28; no message ID (ASM-E044-03); no credential
backendOnlyContracts.scope: one check, in P3 casewf.migration; the P2 integration.internal record that also binds rwb.schema is not checked again

backendOnlyContracts.apiVerifiedAgainst: flyway-core 12.4.0 (local Gradle cache, javap, 18 Nov 2026): Flyway.migrate(), Flyway.validateWithResult() returns ValidateResult with invalidMigrations of ValidateOutput.version, Flyway.info() returns MigrationInfoService with pending() and MigrationInfo.getVersion(); org.flywaydb.core.api.exception.FlywayValidateException extends FlywayException and exposes no invalid-migration list in this version
backendOnlyContracts.behaviour: logs exactly one ERROR line, then rethrows the same FlywayException so the context fails and the service does not start; a refused clean() is not wrapped

backendOnlyContracts.toolingPackage: th.co.scb.ace.demo.recovery.architecture.migration (test scope; JUnit tests may share it and are excluded from coverage by name)
backendOnlyContracts.ruleInterface: MigrationRule#ruleId(); MigrationRule#check(ParsedMigrationFile, FolderContext); MigrationRule#checkFolder(FolderContext) default returns no finding, NameRule overrides it for non-.sql folder entries
backendOnlyContracts.findingIdentity: one finding per (rule, file, line, key); L-LITERAL-SCHEMA key is the disallowed schema name; L-FK-OUTSIDE key is the referenced qualifier; L-SEARCH-PATH and L-GRANT have no key; L-LEX key is the opener offset
backendOnlyContracts.extensionPoint: LiteralSchemaRule#isAllowedQualifier(MigrationStatement, String) returns true only for ${recoverySchema}, information_schema and pg_catalog; no public exception (SEAM-E044-01, owner RWB-E1-069)
